title: Jungle Cruise Sails to No. 1
description: The Disney film, starring Emily Blunt and Dwayne Johnson, is riding to an estimated 32 million dollar opening weekend at the domestic box office. Based on the famed theme park ride, it took in 13.3 million from 4,310 theaters on Friday alone.

title: John Cena on Joining Fast and Furious
description: Joining one of the most famous film franchises of all time is a daunting endeavor, even if you are already very famous in your own right. Just ask John Cena, who made his debut as Jakob Toretto in F9 and admits the cast dynamic was a challenge of its own.

title: The Suicide Squad Earns Early Praise
description: James Gunn's The Suicide Squad is almost upon us and the hype keeps growing. Margot Robbie has called it one of the best comic book films she has worked on, and everyone involved seems convinced it is something special.

title: Marvel Announces Next Phase Line-Up
description: Marvel Studios revealed its upcoming slate at a packed convention hall, confirming release windows for several long-rumoured sequels and introducing three new characters to the shared universe.

title: Denis Villeneuve Confirms Dune Sequel
description: Following a strong opening weekend, the studio has greenlit the second part of the adaptation. Villeneuve confirmed that pre-production has already started and that filming will begin next summer.

title: Streaming Numbers Beat Box Office Again
description: For the third month in a row, streaming premieres outperformed theatrical releases in total viewing hours. Analysts say the shift is changing how studios plan their release windows.

title: Oscar Nominations Announced
description: The Academy revealed this year's nominees early this morning. Two independent films lead the field with eleven nominations each, while the most expensive blockbuster of the year walked away with only two technical nods.

title: Classic Trilogy Gets 4K Restoration
description: The original trilogy has been scanned from the negatives and restored frame by frame. The release includes over four hours of previously unseen behind the scenes footage.

title: Director Reveals Cut Ending
description: In a lengthy interview the director explained why the original ending never made it into theaters, describing test screenings where audiences reportedly walked out confused and unhappy.

title: Cinema Chains Report Record Summer
description: Ticket sales across the largest chains rose sharply compared to last year. Operators credit a packed release calendar and the return of premium large format screenings.

title: Animation Studio Announces Original Film
description: After a decade of sequels, the studio is returning to original storytelling with a hand drawn feature set in a coastal town. The project is scheduled for release in two years.

title: Lead Actor Exits Franchise
description: Citing scheduling conflicts and a desire to work on smaller projects, the actor confirmed they will not return for the fourth installment. The studio says the role will be recast.

title: Film Festival Adds Streaming Category
description: For the first time, the festival will accept films that premiere on streaming platforms. The decision ends a long standing rule that had excluded several award contenders.

title: Score Composer Wins Lifetime Award
description: The composer behind some of the most recognisable film themes of the last forty years received a lifetime achievement award at a ceremony attended by directors from across the industry.

title: Sequel Delayed to Next Spring
description: The studio moved the release date back by five months, citing unfinished visual effects work. Analysts see the move as an attempt to avoid competing with two other major releases.

title: Horror Film Breaks Genre Record
description: Made on a modest budget, the film has become the highest grossing horror release of the decade. Its director has already signed a two picture deal off the back of the success.

title: Actress Makes Directing Debut
description: After more than twenty years in front of the camera, she has stepped behind it. Her debut feature premiered to a standing ovation and picked up a distribution deal within days.

title: Documentary Series Sparks Debate
description: The six part documentary has drawn both praise and criticism for its portrayal of events. The filmmakers have defended their approach and released additional interview footage.

title: Studio Restores Lost Silent Film
description: A print thought lost for nearly a century has been recovered from a private collection and painstakingly restored. It will screen publicly for the first time since its original run.

title: Box Office Recovers to Pre-2020 Levels
description: Global ticket revenue has returned to levels last seen before the pandemic, according to a new industry report. Growth was strongest in markets where premium formats expanded fastest.
